input.change_text: Added `ChatSessionItemControllerNewItemHandler` so that controllers can specify the URI used for new sessions.

output.subject: `ChatSessionItemControllerNewItemHandler` lets controllers set the new-session URI
output.action_text: Implement `ChatSessionItemControllerNewItemHandler` on chat-session-item controllers (VS Code v1.110+) to specify the URI used when a new session opens. Opt-in extension API; existing controllers without the handler fall back to the previous default URI selection.
